item.text: {"analysis":"The trial executed successfully but reduced pinned-host macro validation HR@10 to 0.4375, versus the supplied 0.5000 exponential-pooling result and historical 0.5237 attention/preference result. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.455, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.490, Electronics 0.360, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.445. Untying embeddings therefore did not improve this configuration. A plausible explanation is that separate target embeddings remove useful parameter sharing and increase estimation demands; the reported results do not establish the cause. Electronics remained the weakest category. No test metrics were available.","code_summary":"Trained one independent ConvRec per category with separate, jointly trained history and target embedding tables. History embeddings feed eight causal residual convolution blocks, causal two-head attention, and learned exponential preference pooling fused through a gate. Target embeddings and a learned item bias score candidates using 32-negative cross-entropy supervision. Training uses AdamW, cosine learning-rate decay, and validation checkpoint selection. The generated predictor strictly loads exactly one selected checkpoint per category and preserves dataset routing. Code includes checks for embedding gradients, causality, finite padded outputs, and checkpoint-reload prediction parity."}
